cases.sentence: В ___, когда верховный военачальник пришел в город Аждод.
cases.translation: In the year when the supreme commander came to the city of Ashdod.
cases.explain: The accusative expresses temporal reference when used with prepositions like в.

cases.translation: Sent by the king of Assyria Sargon.
cases.explain: The genitive expresses possession: the king of Assyria.

cases.sentence: Сними рубище с ___ тела и сандалии с ног.
cases.translation: Remove the sackcloth from your body and sandals from your feet.
cases.explain: The preposition с (from) requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Сними рубище с тела и ___ с ног.
cases.explain: The preposition с (from) requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Он сделал это и ходил раздетый и ___ во знамение.
cases.translation: He did this and walked naked and barefoot as a sign.
cases.explain: The adjective босой agrees with the subject ходил in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Три ___ ходил раздетый и босой во знамение.
cases.translation: Three years walked naked and barefoot as a sign.
cases.explain: The genitive is used with numerals: три года (three years).

cases.sentence: Как знак грядущего для ___ и Куша.
cases.translation: As a sign for Egypt and Ethiopia.
cases.explain: The genitive expresses the beneficiary or recipient of the sign.
The genitive follows prepositions expressing purpose or result.

reading.ru: В год, когда верховный военачальник, посланный царем Осирии Саргоном, пришел к городу Аждоду.
reading.question: Who came to Ashdod and under whose authority?
options: The supreme commander sent by the king of Assyria Sargon
The king himself leading an army
reading.correct: The supreme commander sent by the king of Assyria Sargon
reading.explain: The text identifies the visitor as Sargon's commander coming to Ashdod.

reading.ru: Господь говорил через Исайю сына Амоца.
reading.question: Through whom does the Lord speak?
options: Through Isaiah the son of Amoz
reading.correct: Through Isaiah the son of Amoz
reading.explain: The text explicitly names Isaiah as God's prophet delivering the message.

reading.ru: Он сказал ему, «Сними рубище с тела и сандалии с ног».
reading.question: What command does God give to Isaiah?
options: Remove sackcloth from your body and sandals from your feet
Put on royal robes and ornaments
Go to the temple and pray
Gather the people for an assembly
reading.correct: Remove sackcloth from your body and sandals from your feet
reading.explain: God directly commands Isaiah to remove his garments and footwear.

reading.ru: Как мой слуга Исаия три года ходил раздетый и босой во знамение.
reading.question: How long was Isaiah to walk naked and barefoot?
options: For three years as a sign
For the rest of his life
reading.correct: For three years as a sign
reading.explain: The text specifies a three-year period for this sign to the people.

reading.ru: Так царь Осирии уведет раздетых и босых египетских пленников.
reading.question: What will the king of Assyria do to Egyptian prisoners?
options: Lead them away naked and barefoot as captives
Treat them with honor and respect
reading.correct: Lead them away naked and barefoot as captives
reading.explain: Isaiah's sign prophesies the shameful captivity and humiliation of Egyptians.

reading.ru: Те, кто надеялся на куш и хвалился Египтом, ужаснутся и будут опозорены.
reading.question: What will happen to those who relied on Ethiopia and Egypt?
options: They will be dismayed and ashamed
They will find safety and protection
reading.correct: They will be dismayed and ashamed
reading.explain: Those who trusted in these powers will experience terror and disgrace.
